chunks: Solomon was heir to David, and he said: 'O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given of everything. This is indeed a clear favour.'
ai.seo_question: What unique gifts did Prophet Solomon receive according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Solomon’s (AS) unique spiritual and intellectual inheritance from David (AS), emphasizing that his mastery of 'manṭiq al-ṭayr' (language of birds) symbolizes the ability to discern the subtle signs of God in creation. It highlights the concept of divine favor (faḍl mubīn) not merely as power, but as a profound epistemological gift that validates prophetic authority and wisdom.
